title: unified-rollouts-shadow-canary-autorollback-safety-guards
author: Maya Chen
description:
Motivation: Improve safety and observability for shadow/canary workflows in unified rollouts. Production incidents exposed two classes of failure: (1) noisy metric spikes from synthetic shadow traffic causing unnecessary rollbacks, and (2) races between automated rollback and manual operator overrides during canary windows. This PR introduces conservative safety guards, multi-metric matching, and new operator controls to reduce false-positive auto-rollbacks while preserving automated protection.

What this change does: Adds throttles and a smoothing window for shadow traffic metrics; implements multi-metric thresholds (latency + error-rate + quality regression) using an AND/OR configurable policy; introduces a cooldown and operator-lock flag to prevent automated rollbacks immediately after manual interventions; adds new console UI flags to visualize shadow traffic distribution and to temporarily pause auto-rollback for a rollout; improves rollout controller reconciliation to avoid double-rollback races; adds extensive unit and e2e tests including synthetic regression tests and a canary-to-shadow transition test.

Key design choices: (1) Use configurable metric buckets and exponential smoothing to reduce sensitivity to single-bucket spikes. (2) Require at least two out of three metrics to breach thresholds by default for an auto-rollback to trigger (configurable per rollout). (3) Centralize rollback decision logic in the rollout controller to ensure atomicity and use optimistic concurrency to avoid conflicting operator actions. (4) Maintain a compact audit trail in the rollout status to show which guard triggered the action.

Checklist: - [x] Core controller logic and API changes implemented - [x] Console UI: pause / operator-lock + visualization - [x] Config schema version bump (v2) and migration helpers - [x] Unit tests for rollback logic and smoothing windows - [x] Integration tests (simulated metrics) - [x] E2E tests for canary, A/B and shadow flows - [x] Docs and release notes

Backward compatibility: Config schema bumped but migration is additive; default behavior preserves current auto-rollback semantics (conservative matching disabled by default for existing clusters).

feat(rollouts): implement multi-metric matching engine and policy parsing
fix(rollouts): prevent concurrent rollback during operator override (optimistic lock)
feat(console): add pause/lock controls and shadow traffic dashboard
chore(config): bump rollout API schema to v2 and add migration helper
test(rollouts): add unit and integration tests for autorollback policies
test(e2e): add synthetic regression and canary-to-shadow transition tests
docs(rollouts): document new guards, thresholds, and console workflows
review_comments: Liam O'Neill: Can you explain why we chose 2-out-of-3 metric matching as the default? Seems potentially permissive for some customers.

Maya Chen: Default 2-of-3 is a conservative tradeoff between sensitivity and noise; docs explain how to configure it per-rollout. We also added a smoothing window to avoid transient spikes counting toward breach.
Priya Kapoor: The console lock UI looks good. Please add an explicit audit event when an operator engages the lock so SREs can trace decisions.
Maya Chen: Added audit event emission in controller and surfaced the last-lock event in the rollout status. Updated tests to assert audit payload.
Samir Gupta: CI flake: one integration test timed out on the first run (metrics ingestion test). Can we make the test harness wait for the ingestion window?
Maya Chen: Adjusted the test harness to wait for metrics ingestion and increased timeouts; re-ran CI and the build passed.
Liam O'Neill: Approving after the last round of safety tweaks and test hardening.
Priya Kapoor: Approved. Happy with docs and migration plan.
merge_commit_message:
squash: unified rollouts: shadow/canary autorollback safety guards (Maya Chen)

Adds smoothing, multi-metric matching, operator-lock, console controls, tests and docs.
release_notes: Add safety guards for unified rollouts: smoothing window for shadow metrics, configurable multi-metric auto-rollback policies (default 2-of-3), operator-lock/pause controls in Console, and controller fixes to avoid rollback/operator races. Defaults preserve previous behavior; see docs for config and migration.
notes_for_reviewers: Focus review on decision_engine.go and controller optimistic locking changes. Pay special attention to the migration helper in schema.yaml to ensure existing rollout CRs are not rejected. The console changes are mostly UI wiring; security review for the operator-lock endpoint was done by Security team before merge.
